title: Showcase Skin Pack Expansion — Zombie Garden, Cozy Cabin, Non-Euclidean & Amphibious
objective: Materialize four owner-requested post-UISR showcase Skin Packs through the shared Skin Pack runtime: zombies + exotic flowers, cozy-play cozy cabin, non-Euclidean with visibly impossible UI framing/geometry, and frogs/amphibious; preserve shared application semantics, accessibility, recoverability and presentation-only authority.

included: register and materialize zombie-garden, cozy-cabin, non-euclidean and amphibious-frogs through the shared Skin Pack runtime
define distinctive tokens/material/frame/ornament/typography/effect presentation contracts without gameplay/application semantic forks

make non-euclidean visibly non-Euclidean through deterministic presentational panel/frame geometry, impossible-angle offsets, nonparallel framing, nested perspective cues and bounded spatial dissonance while preserving logical DOM order, focus order, hit targets and readable content
include the four packs in gallery/assignment/persistence/full-capability packaging surfaces
add focused tests for registry, identity, non-Euclidean geometry boundaries, package manifests and full-capability inclusion
run exact-head validation and serialize application publication through OPS3 FIFO
excluded: gameplay, rules, permissions, hidden-information, validation, provenance, AI or navigation authority changes
semantic reordering or DOM/task-topology mutation in non-euclidean
randomized control movement, inaccessible distortion, pointer-only interaction, reduced legibility or deceptive hitbox geometry
new skin identities beyond the four owner-requested packs
scope.completion_gate: All four packs selectable through shared runtime; package/full-capability surfaces include them; non-Euclidean demonstrates deterministic presentational geometry without changing interaction semantics; focused/exact-head validation passes; publication is durably verified; UISR lane is atomically reconciled.

selection_boundaries: New post-terminal UISR expansion selected directly by owner; does not reopen UISR-10.
Non-Euclidean geometry authority is presentational only; logical task topology, focus order, hit targets and semantics stay application-owned.
All four packs remain declarative/non-executable and share runtime behavior.
next_action: No UISR-11 work remains. Later UI skin changes require a newly governed ui-implementation work item.

stop_reason.evidence: UISR-11 implementation, exact-head cross-platform validation, FIFO application publication and control-plane closeout are durably verified.

execution_conformance.note: Product completion remains valid. The attempt required a second owner Continue after a stall/freeze report; this is recorded rather than falsely certified as clean single-Continue execution.

tdd.red_failure_reason: Public @multiversal/ui-system API lacked getShowcaseSkinPackDefinitions / resolveShowcaseSkinPresentation; all five focused UISR-11 acceptance tests failed at that missing runtime boundary.

publication_incident.symptom: A malformed Git-tree construction produced a 3953-file candidate with repository-wide deletions.
publication_incident.disposition: Detected before merge; never published. Candidate rebuilt from the real FIFO turn-base tree and verified as an 11-file diff before exact-head validation and merge.
